svg.title: TR-04 planned exhaustive workflow and independent verification
svg.desc: A source-pinned checkpoint preflight precedes three parallel field shards. Each shard evaluates all selectors and both base sizes, retains all failed mass, runs independent verification and produces exact rank and separate work vectors. Aggregation reconciles the complete finite census. No measured outcome appears in this planned diagram.
